{{Top|leg}}
The '''Vandronian government''' was a government operating within the [[Vandron system/Legends|Vandron system]]<ref name="Heroes">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim's]] [[D'Aelgoth sector/Legends|D'Aelgoth sector]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> at some point following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Heroes" /> of [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Vandronian government was mentioned in the [[1995]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement ''[[Heroes & Rogues]]'', which was written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and [[Rick D. Stuart|Rick Stuart]] for [[West End Games]].<ref name="Heroes" />
